findings.title: Federated rule immutability lost for CombinedRule callers
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` is now implemented by delegating to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`, but `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` hardcodes `isFederated = false` and has no access to the original rule group. The previous `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` checked `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`, which made update and delete abilities unsupported for federated rule groups. As a result, callers using `useAlertRuleAbility`/`useAlertRuleAbilities` with a `CombinedRule` will now treat federated data-source rule groups as mutable, allowing edit/delete actions to be shown and invoked when they should be blocked.

findings.title: skipToken path still evaluates Grafana permissions and can allow Duplicate for cloud rules
findings.body: `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` maps `skipToken` to `undefined` and calls `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined)`. For a missing rule, `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` returns `loading: false`, so `MaybeSupported` becomes `AlwaysSupported` and `duplicateSupported` becomes true. The hook then evaluates `getRulesPermissions('grafana')`. In `AlertRuleMenu`, this hook is called with `skipToken` for non-Grafana (cloud) Prom rules, so a user with Grafana rule-create permission but without the data source's create permission can see Duplicate enabled for a cloud rule even though the ruler-based ability would deny it.

findings.title: Delete and pause actions are still gated on rulerRule, so they disappear in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `RuleActionsButtons` with only `promRule`, so `AlertRuleMenu` receives `rulerRule` as undefined. However, Delete is still rendered only when `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165), and Pause is still rendered only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` is true (line 123). The component now computes `canDelete` and `canPause` from Prom-based abilities, but users cannot ever see or use those actions in the list view because the old ruler-based guards remain.

findings.title: Silence menu item is shown in ruler-less list view but the drawer is never rendered
findings.body: `AlertRuleMenu` can show the Silence notifications item based on the new Prom-based `canSilence` ability, and clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)`. But `RuleActionsButtons` only renders `<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer>` when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the new list path `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined, so the drawer is never rendered. The user sees and can click Silence, but nothing happens.

findings.title: Missing React key on GrafanaRuleListItem in FilterView
findings.body: In `rules.map`, the computed `key` is passed to `DataSourceRuleLoader` and `UnknownRuleListItem`, but the Grafana branch renders `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` without `key={key}`. React falls back to index keys, so list items can be reconciled incorrectly when rules are appended, reordered, or filtered, and React will emit a key warning.
